TaxRateRequest.description: A new rate of a tax code from a date (inclusive), with the code's `version` it was based on.
TaxRateRequest.title: TaxRateRequest

TransitionRequest.description: A document transition (submit, approve): the version it was based on is optional, a comment too.
TransitionRequest.title: TransitionRequest

UploadImportRequest.description:
Multipart upload of a CSV or XLSX file: `kind` (contacts, accounts, opening_balances, invoices, bank_lines), `file` (up to
`imports.max_bytes`), optional `delimiter` for CSV (default: detected), and `options` — `number_locale` (us|eu|plain, default plain),
`date_format` (default Y-m-d) and the kind's own: `as_of` for opening balances, `bank_account_id` (and `sign`, `opening_balance`,
`closing_balance`) for bank lines. The file is read here and only its rows are kept. Row and column limits come from config.
UploadImportRequest.title: UploadImportRequest

UploadIntentRequest.description: POST …/attachments/uploads: what is being attached to, and the file's name, claimed type, size and SHA-256.
UploadIntentRequest.title: UploadIntentRequest
